##### Decision Variables

$x_i \geq 0$: number of units of product $i$ that will be fulfilled (continuous).  

##### Objective Function

$\displaystyle \max \sum_{i=1}^{68} r_i\,x_i$

##### Constraints

1. Demand satisfaction: $\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^{68} x_i \geq \sum_{i=1}^{68} d_i$ (equivalently, each $x_i \le d_i$).  
2. Inventory limitation: $\displaystyle x_i \le I_i,\quad \forall i=1,\dots ,68$  
3. Non‑negativity: $x_i \ge 0,\quad \forall i=1,\dots ,68$
